What we offer

Coloron’s Time & Attendance Solution simplifies and modernizes corporate and SMB workforce time management. The solution integrates contactless biometric authentication, automated shift scheduling, mobile clock-in, and centralized multi-branch attendance reporting across diverse industries.

From standalone retail storefronts needing zero-server simplicity to multi-building corporate campuses requiring ERP payroll integration, Coloron provides agile, modular deployments.

Small Scale Attendance

For boutiques, cafes, clinics, and branch offices. Standalone Wi-Fi MinMoe terminals connected to Coloron Cloud for direct smartphone management without local servers.

View SMB Solution

Medium & Large Scale Attendance

For enterprise headquarters, factories, schools, and distributed chains. Centralized HikCentral management, biometric turnstiles, and automated payroll API integration.

View Enterprise Solution

Biometric authentication methods

Coloron's MinMoe series terminals utilize high-performance deep learning algorithms to provide touchless, instantaneous identification, ensuring smooth shift handovers with absolute identity certainty.

Ultra-Fast 0.2s Face Verification
Deep learning facial recognition verifies staff in less than 0.2 seconds at distances up to 3 meters, preventing entrance bottlenecks during peak shift changes.
Deep Learning Anti-Spoofing Algorithm
Dual-lens stereo camera with infrared depth measurement detects live tissue, totally blocking fraud attempts using printed photographs, phone video playbacks, or 3D masks.
Multi-Modal Identification Options
Accommodates every employee preference with face, fingerprint, RFID card, PIN, and dynamic smartphone Bluetooth / QR code credentials in a single terminal.
WDR Low-Light & Backlight Performance
120dB Wide Dynamic Range lenses maintain 99%+ accuracy even when mounted directly facing strong daylight glass storefronts or under dim ambient hallway lights.

Recommended solution

Small Scale Solution Highlights:
  • No local server required: Standalone MinMoe terminals connect via Wi-Fi to Coloron Cloud.
  • Mobile clock-in & check: Managers schedule shifts and view real-time clock-in records anytime via mobile app.
  • Hygienic touchless clock-in: Avoids cross-contamination and works reliably with face masks.
  • One-click export: Generates formatted Excel payroll and overtime reports in seconds.
